name: promote
description:
Promotes an entity's memory state one level: dormant->active, silent->dormant, unavailable->silent. Active stays active.

CALL WHEN: A dormant or silent memory becomes relevant again — e.g., an entity is referenced in new context after a period of inactivity.
RETURNS: The new memory state after promotion.
Cost: ~5ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.

name: demote
description:
Demotes an entity's memory state one level: active->dormant, dormant->silent, silent->unavailable. Unavailable stays unavailable.

CALL WHEN: A memory is no longer relevant to the current context, or during periodic decay sweeps. Demoted memories are still retrievable but with lower priority.
RETURNS: The new memory state after demotion.
Cost: ~5ms.

duration_ms.description: Server-side tool execution duration in milliseconds.

requested_tool.description: Tool name requested by the client, after alias resolution.

tool.description: Canonical tool name that handled the call.
